Returns per-user and per-domain breakdowns of URL visits, which is individual browsing activity; the metric totals are registered as queryUrlVisits.

chromemanagement.customers.reports.findS.reason: Returns per-browser web-app visit history (first and last navigation times by browser), which is browsing activity rather than an aggregate; findSaasUsage covers the per-app totals.
Returns per-user profile web-app visit history (first and last navigation times by user profile), which is browsing activity rather than an aggregate; findSaasUsage covers the per-app totals.

chromemanagement.customers.telemetry.not.reason: Creates a notification channel that publishes device telemetry to a caller-named Pub/Sub topic, possibly in another organization's project.
No single-config read exists to prove a notification config belongs to the customer before it is deleted, and Discovery lists only a read-only scope.

chromemanagement.customers.thirdPartyPro.reason: Moves a third-party profile user named only by an opaque ID to a caller-chosen org unit, and no registered read proves the user belongs to the customer.
